author: Camemes
body:
Hello, this is my map. I called it battlefield because it looks like an ancient war ground where the war is still continuing. A lot of thought and effort went into this project so i hope you like it and will accept it.

Images: http://imgur.com/a/KjRfB Here you can see the images of the map.

Dropbox download: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/3trz7z4eslhqlgz/AADxHIaJx9vDZMLSeqCcT6Gta?dl=0 Here you can download the map.

YAML Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/n0t9h6i9wi4z6k3/Format%20Proper.yaml?dl=0 Here is the download link for the YAML.

There are 2 teams, each team contains 5 islands: 1 spawn, 2 iron and 2 monuments. In the center is really good loot under the lava along with diamond blocks, I have a feeling that everyone will rush that island off the spawn. Underneath all the islands are stone,webs and air which gives players a place to pvp with risk involved.

title: [DTM] Battlefield V1.0

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Opinion's
-Too blocky
-Not much room for pvp
-People can knocked off easily.

I don't think this would have great game-play, because of the excessive holes shown. If you improved the map, by maybe taking out the bits and adding islands, it would provide better game-play. Make the spawns and other structures, "less blocky" by adding some designs and such. Expand on the area,  add more islands and try different variations in blocks. These are just some suggestions! :D

replies.body:
There's minimal PvP space, kinda blocky, lacking detail and plain and dull.
This map wouldn't play very well as people can EASILY be knocked into the void, and its kinda small

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
The map looks very blocky/chunky. Rounding edges off and such would make the map looks a lot better.

With all the "parkour" I think that archers will easily dominate. Shooting people off can be extremely easy and even in melee combat a lot of the times you will kill them by knocking them off the platform.

Another thing I noticed is I don't even think the map is symmetrical.

Every map has potential and every map maker has potential but this map is very poorly made. Sorry but this is not that good of a map. I don't even think its worth improving it. I'd rather start over.

replies.author: Slvrflash
replies.body: Good effort! However, as the others have previously mentioned, PVP may be a bit difficult as there isn't much room to fight. Also, a floor pattern and more texture in the map would make it more aesthetically pleasing. Interesting idea, though, and I hope you don't get discouraged by the criticism. Just trying to help! :D
